criteria.text:
Given a git worktree, a run dir, and a captured spec whose only Scenarios-section criterion is a holdout
When `faff spec commit --issue EX-3 --title "add a thing" --spec <file> --worktree <wt> --run-dir <rd> --json` runs
Then it exits 0 with token "committed"
And its JSON has a "warnings" array whose one entry starts with "over-withholding advisory"
And stderr has a line starting "spec commit EX-3: warning: over-withholding advisory"
And <rd>/EX-3/spec-commit.json has the same "warnings" array
criteria.exercised: Fixture /tmp/e1: git worktree wt (one init commit), empty run dir rd, spec.md whose only Scenarios unit is a ```holdout fence (plus a DONE item). Ran `faff spec commit --issue EX-3 --title "add a thing" --spec /tmp/e1/spec.md --worktree /tmp/e1/wt --run-dir /tmp/e1/rd --json`, captured stdout/stderr/exit, read rd/EX-3/spec-commit.json and compared warnings arrays with node.
criteria.expected: exit 0, token committed; JSON warnings array with one entry starting 'over-withholding advisory'; stderr line starting 'spec commit EX-3: warning: over-withholding advisory'; record warnings equal to the JSON warnings
criteria.observed: exit=0; token "committed"; warnings = ["over-withholding advisory: the builder view retains ZERO born-verifiable Scenarios-section criteria (the full spec had >= 1) — consider marking fewer scenarios as holdout"] (length 1); stderr exactly one line 'spec commit EX-3: warning: over-withholding advisory: ...'; spec-commit.json warnings JSON-equal to result warnings (node check true); record also holdouts_withheld 1, commit_subject_scheme conventional

criteria.text:
Given a git worktree with no conventions override, a run dir, and a captured spec with one non-holdout scenario
When `faff spec commit --issue EX-3 --title "add a thing" --spec <file> --worktree <wt> --run-dir <rd> --json` runs
Then its JSON has "commit_subject_scheme" "conventional" and no "warnings" key
And the commit at HEAD has the subject "docs(EX-3): add spec for add a thing"
And <rd>/EX-3/spec-commit.json has "commit_subject_scheme" "conventional" and "warnings" []
criteria.exercised: Fixture /tmp/e2: git worktree wt with no .faff dir / conventions override, empty run dir rd, spec.md with one plain (non-holdout) fenced scenario. Ran `faff spec commit --issue EX-3 --title "add a thing" --spec /tmp/e2/spec.md --worktree /tmp/e2/wt --run-dir /tmp/e2/rd --json`; read HEAD subject and the record.
criteria.expected: JSON commit_subject_scheme 'conventional' and no warnings key; HEAD subject 'docs(EX-3): add spec for add a thing'; record commit_subject_scheme 'conventional' and warnings []
criteria.observed: exit=0, token committed; JSON {issue,token,path,commit,source_check,commit_subject_scheme:"conventional"} with no warnings key (node 'warnings' in o = false); stderr empty; git log -1 subject 'docs(EX-3): add spec for add a thing'; spec-commit.json has "warnings": [] and "commit_subject_scheme": "conventional"

criteria.text:
Given the same worktree after that commit
When the same `faff spec commit … --json` runs again
Then it exits 0 with token "already-committed" and "commit_subject_scheme" "conventional"
And <rd>/EX-3/spec-commit.json is byte-identical to before
criteria.exercised: Same /tmp/e2 worktree after the scenario-2 commit; saved the record (rec-before.json, sha256 7c936580...), re-ran the identical `faff spec commit ... --json` command, then cmp'd the record.
criteria.expected: exit 0, token already-committed, commit_subject_scheme 'conventional'; spec-commit.json byte-identical to before
criteria.observed: exit=0; JSON {token:"already-committed", commit same 76353b48..., commit_subject_scheme:"conventional"} with no warnings key; stderr empty; record sha256 7c93658078a1... before and after, cmp reports identical; no new commit in git log, clean status

delegated.text: `spec commit` prints each `dodSplit` warning to stderr, returns them as `warnings`, and records them in `spec-commit.json`, with token and exit unchanged.
`spec commit` returns and records `commit_subject_scheme`, the value its commit subject was built from.
`faff-graft/SKILL.md` Steps 4c and 10 read `commit_subject_scheme` from `spec-commit.json`, with the `faff conventions get commit_subject` fallback, and Step 4 logs `warnings`.
`test/spec-commit.test.mjs` passes under `node --test`, with the cases in §4.2.
`npm run build` leaves the committed `spec-commit.js` and `build-manifest.json` matching the `.ts`.
